list: Leonida single-player platinum route — 55 PS5 trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 single-player trophies to receive the platinum automatically. Use the remaining unchecked entries to finish your Leonida run; multiplayer is not required.

roadmap.note: Awarded after all other trophies.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing at the start of Chapter 1. Follow the main objectives until the mission ends; this unlock is part of the story.

roadmap.note: First Chapter 1 mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Continue the main story through the transition out of Chapter 1. If the trophy has not appeared at the chapter break, finish What’s in the Bag? at the start of Chapter 2.

roadmap.note: Remember the meditation before this transition.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 2 storyline and continue into Welcome to Vice City. The chapter trophy unlocks as that opening Chapter 3 mission concludes.

roadmap.note: Advance into Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 and the opening Chapter 4 missions Ocean Beach and Another Life. Continue the main objectives if the chapter transition alone does not trigger it.

roadmap.note: Complete the transition into Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 main missions, including Starting From Zero. Keep following the story markers until the chapter completion trophy appears.

roadmap.note: Finish the Chapter 4 story arc.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Follow the main storyline to its final mission and complete its objectives. This is a story completion award, so no optional activity grind is necessary for this trophy.

roadmap.note: Finish the campaign before the cleanup stages.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play Breakfast Run during Chapter 2 and complete the mission. This trophy comes from normal story progress rather than a special performance requirement.

roadmap.note: Chapter 2 mission award.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Work through the heist objectives and let the mission finish to collect the automatic story award.

roadmap.note: Chapter 3 heist award.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish Child’s Play during Chapter 4. Follow the rescue mission through its conclusion; there is no separate trophy challenge to perform along the way.

roadmap.note: Chapter 4 rescue mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the main mission Headliners in Chapter 4. Continue the campaign until this mission becomes available and finish its objectives.

roadmap.note: Chapter 4 mission award.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown as part of the Chapter 4 story. Finish the mission rather than trying to recreate its airport action in free roam.

roadmap.note: Chapter 4 airport mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Advance to Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5 and finish the mission. The trophy is tied to completing the story assignment.

roadmap.note: Chapter 5 mission award.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the campaign, open Progress → Stats → 100% Completion and finish every listed requirement. Start vehicle scans and animal studies early: the checklist needs 200 base vehicle models and 100 studied animals, alongside its other tasks.

roadmap.note: Use the in-game checklist rather than clearing every map icon.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 different stunts across jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. Mix categories to avoid difficult routes, and check Progress → Activities → Stunts for regional gaps; the 100% checklist ultimately asks for 300.

roadmap.note: Combine stunt categories during the map sweep.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, racing and a stunt. Check the nine activity categories in Progress so you can identify anything you have not tried.

roadmap.note: Sample activities while travelling.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit all 12 shooting ranges and earn gold in each of their 42 challenges. Revisit any challenge below gold and improve your accuracy and pace until every medal meets the target.

roadmap.note: Track every range and challenge medal.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Visit each of the 14 Top Fun locations and win a drone race there. Record locations as you go so repeated wins at one venue do not replace a missing venue.

roadmap.note: Win at every drone-racing venue.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races rather than repeating one easy event. There are 40 unique race locations, so move to another course whenever you log a first win.

roadmap.note: Count unique race wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After Feng Shui in Chapter 1, watch for Cal’s fishing invitation by text. Visit the purple marker west of Key Lento and beat his fishing challenge.

roadmap.note: Follow Cal’s invitation after meeting him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish every level of one video game; you do not need all its extra challenges. Try Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on a home TV, or find a Bang For Your Buck arcade machine.

roadmap.note: Finish one game rather than merely starting it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and respond to Andy’s call and address message in Belville. Follow her strand from Climbing the Cellerichain through Puff Puff Pass to finish the chain.

roadmap.note: Lucia’s Andy strand remains available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton’s treasure-diving jobs after Island Dreams, recovering treasures from seven shipwrecks and returning them to him. If his marker disappears after Chapter 1, continue the story until he contacts Jason again.

roadmap.note: Finish Kenton’s treasure sets when his jobs are available.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, visit Billy at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five-job strand, starting with Thrillbillies and ending with Hometown Heroes.

roadmap.note: Finish the entire Billy mission chain.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger storylines and check the trophy tracker after each completed strand. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed examples; do not assume every optional contact counts as a stranger.

roadmap.note: Use the trophy tracker to confirm qualifying strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: After Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ Gs, deliver the vehicles on Randy’s 16-car wish list. Use WAiNK to check sports cars and consult Map → Robberies → Randy’s Wish List for the remaining requests.

roadmap.note: Deliver the requested models to Randy’s Vice City garage.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: As Jason, continue Tyrone’s jobs after Here, Kitty Kitty and destroy the marked synthetic labs for Take Out Kitty Litter. Finish the follow-up Spin On This mission to close his strand.

roadmap.note: Jason must handle Tyrone’s lab jobs.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Before leaving Chapter 1, visit Jason’s house in the morning after Down to Earth, speak to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and accept her optional meditation; keep a save because whether this one-time session is required remains uncertain. Then complete the meditation spots across Leonida, using both partners where available after Coffee Break and checking Progress → Collections → Exploration → Meditations.

roadmap.note: Potentially missable: safeguard Lucia’s Chapter 1 balcony session.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, play as Jason and follow Bret’s message to Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Work through the marked Target Deck hunts and deliver the requested animals; the source has not yet confirmed which unique animal triggers this trophy.

roadmap.note: Start Bret’s hunting strand as Jason.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Choose three card sets and collect every card belonging to each chosen set. Concentrate on completing sets instead of spreading your search across all 18 without finishing any.

roadmap.note: Finish three whole sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK to scan 100 environmental locations, including landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags. Scan new discoveries as you explore; repeat scans at the same location will not fill the missing entries.

roadmap.note: Scan environmental discoveries, not just vehicles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Open Progress → Challenges and complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Let story and activity play fill easy entries first, then select manageable leftovers; 100% completion will require 70.

roadmap.note: Save targeted challenge cleanup until other activities are done.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, bring Jason and Lucia together and reach four wanted stars. Break pursuit, then leave the wider red heat zone too; the railway tunnel north of Ambrosia can help block police sightlines.

roadmap.note: Keep both partners present until the heat clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Bring your partner after Coffee Break and rob three nearby shops while keeping an active flashing wanted level between them. Take loot at each stop and allow a short delay after the third robbery; use another shop if pursuit began too late for the first to count.

roadmap.note: Maintain active police pursuit through the robbery chain.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan unfamiliar cars, bikes, boats and aircraft with WAiNK until you have discovered 100 vehicles. Check Progress → Vehicles for missing categories, and keep scanning toward the larger 100% requirement.

roadmap.note: Build the vehicle database during ordinary travel.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Find five criminals close together at a gang operation, prepare your Focus meter and use an accurate rapid-firing weapon. Activate Combat Focus once and take all five down before it ends; higher Focus and Adrenaline give you more time.

roadmap.note: Attempt this after developing Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Board a passenger jet attached to a terminal boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport; the E3/E4 plane is one option. Enter its upstairs cockpit, reverse away, take off and fly roughly a kilometre from the airport.

roadmap.note: Use a terminal-docked jet rather than an airfield plane.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Visit Mile Zero Air Station on the southwestern island in Mariana County and steal a tank from the southern part of the base. Drive it and engage enemies until the trophy registers.

roadmap.note: Prepare for military resistance at the air station.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Complete Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs to unlock jewelry robberies and the Snap Gun, then use it on a store’s rear door. Find the safe code, take the safe contents, disable the alarm and erase camera footage before leaving unseen.

roadmap.note: Use the quiet rear entrance and remove evidence.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Complete That’s Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 to unlock large-bank robberies. Use Yasmani’s security-van tips, follow each van to an open vault, bring your partner for the cash and escape after five different bank jobs.

roadmap.note: Five vaults earn the trophy; all eight serve 100% completion.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Intercept an armored truck near a Vice City bank, open its rear doors with a sticky bomb, take the money and escape the heat zone. The armored-truck and bank sequence introduced by That’s Where The Money Is… is another route to this award.

roadmap.note: The escape is part of the requirement.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Reveal every fogged portion of the map. Use an aircraft to cover remote stretches efficiently, then inspect the map for dark gaps and fly over those areas too.

roadmap.note: Reveal the map across the whole state.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one operation belonging to each of Leonida’s nine gangs. Check Progress → Gangs for each group’s robbery count; the yellow operation markers and the 100% sweep will help cover all nine.

roadmap.note: Cover every gang rather than repeating one gang’s sites.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Visit Ocean View Rooftop Bar at Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini. Stay beside the bar and drink it to trigger the trophy.

roadmap.note: Order the specific cocktail at Ocean View.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: After obtaining the Key Cloner in Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ Gs, steal the blue Banshee inside the showroom in southern Vice City. Drive it through the showroom window and continue along the street until the trophy appears.

roadmap.note: The blue showroom Banshee is required.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn and collect the southeast-office luxury watch, northeast Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun and northeast-office safe contents; the safe code is 0300. Escape police afterward, and revisit when the robbery returns if you missed a valuable.

roadmap.note: Collect all three key valuables and complete the escape.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, take Jason and Lucia to a fitness club together and keep training until both have maximum Strength at the same time. Check each character’s Strength in the character menu; training together develops both partners.

roadmap.note: Keep both characters’ Strength progressing together.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect the criminal profile, such as robbery escapes, destroying evidence or combat encounters. Enable Criminal Profile HUD notifications and let ordinary completion work build the count before doing any extra grinding.

roadmap.note: Check the trophy tracker as profile actions accumulate.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: After Credit Check, return alone as Lucia to the Little Cuba Payday Loans store from the prologue. Rob all three cash drawers, then escape the police and travel far enough away entirely on foot to trigger the award.

roadmap.note: Lucia must return solo and leave without a vehicle.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Go alone to the road northwest of Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2 AM and look for a car with blinking lights. Follow the nearby woodland path to the UFO, speak to the released woman and help her return to the roadside car; leave and retry if the encounter has not spawned.

roadmap.note: The late-night encounter has a variable spawn.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl ’em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride a bike through a crowded Vice City or Ocean Beach area and use the mounted melee kick to hit ten pedestrians within 60 seconds. Choose a busy stretch so you can reach ten targets without long gaps.

roadmap.note: Land ten bike melee hits inside one minute.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After Credit Check unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer, rob banks and Payday Loans shops and take marked cash to a fence such as Yasmani. Launder $250,000 cumulatively; later bank-vault jobs provide large amounts for this total.

roadmap.note: Deliver marked bills across as many robberies as needed.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a combined $100,000 at shops around Leonida. Useful weapons, vehicle modifications and tattoos can raise the total quickly while also supporting your other trophy tasks.

roadmap.note: Shop spending is cumulative.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: After Daily Driver unlocks Vice City Real Estate in Chapter 2, use the phone app to buy all eight purchasable garages. Budget $160,000 altogether; the four garages awarded by the story are separate.

roadmap.note: Buy all eight garages offered for purchase.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Unlock Scooter Bros through the Chapter 2 Moses mission and buy enough garage capacity for ten vehicles. Take suitable stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register; inexpensive vehicles keep registration costs down.

roadmap.note: Expand garage capacity before registering ten vehicles.
